alternatives_considered.approach: Model payments as negative expenses (payer/share rows on a zero-total expense) to reuse the expense write path.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: It would smuggle payments through expense_payer/expense_share, breaking TR-4's readable invariant that balances sum stored expense rows plus stored payment rows and that expense edits never touch payments; a dedicated table keeps the two ledgers independently auditable and the activity kinds distinct.

alternatives_considered.approach: Host the delete control on the activity feed entry instead of a Payments section on the balances screen.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: Feed screens are explicitly out of scope for this piece, so the delete would land in code this ticket does not own; the balances screen already owns settle-up and can list payments newest-first with the same dialog pattern as DeleteExpenseButton.

work_order.approach: Add a payments table per TRD (id, group_id, from_member_id, to_member_id, amount_minor bigint, note, recorded_by, created_at, deleted_at with soft-delete) plus payment.recorded/payment.deleted activity kinds and a 'payment' subject type. Define the payment's balance effect as from += amount and to -= amount (debtor pays creditor), which preserves the zero-sum invariant simplifyDebts asserts. Extend readNetByMember with two payment sums (outgoing by from_member_id, incoming by to_member_id, both filtered to group_id, deleted_at null, and the memberOfGroup predicate) so net = paid - shared + (sumFrom - sumTo); extend listGroupsForUser with the same adjustment keyed by the caller's own membership row so home totals stay the sum of per-group balances (TR-8). Add access helpers createPayment (insert-select-where memberOfGroup guard), softDeletePayment (guarded UPDATE setting deleted_at, authorised by caller memberId being from or to), and readPaymentsForGroup (newest first with resolved names, null for non-members). Add src/app/actions/payments.ts with recordPayment and deletePayment following the expenses.ts shape: Zod parse in-file, requireUser, single db.transaction writing payment row plus exactly one recordActivity entry, typed { ok, fieldErrors, formError } result, revalidatePath('/', 'layout'), money parsed only via src/lib/money.ts parseMajorUnits with the same MAX_INT8 bound. Validation: both members active in the group (unknown member -> fieldErrors on from/to), from != to, amount positive in group currency, note <= 500 chars, archived group refused. Delete: caller must be an active member AND one of the two involved members; double-delete answers success with no second entry. UI: client PaymentForm (from/to selects, amount with fixed currency symbol, optional note, field errors beside fields with focus to first invalid, controlled state, submit Button busyLabel 'Recording…', on success router.refresh()), DeletePaymentButton (Dialog naming the payment, destructive confirm), BalancesScreen Payments list newest-first with per-row delete for involved members only, balances page fetches payments, and GroupOverview describe() gains the two payment kind-only sentences.
assumptions: Group currency is fixed at creation and every payment amount is parsed in it via parseMajorUnits; no per-payment currency field (TRD payment entity lists none).
from/to selects default to the first simplified transfer's debtor/creditor when one exists, else the first two canonical members.
MAX_INT8 bound (9223372036854775807n) applies to payment amounts exactly as to expense amounts, refused beside the amount field.
Delete authorisation requires the caller to be currently active AND one of the two members; a removed caller gets the same 404/unavailable answer as other group writes.

work_order.understanding: Settle-up payments do not exist yet: there is no payments table, no src/app/actions/payments.ts, and BalancesScreen renders a disabled 'Record payment' placeholder (sole caller: the balances page). Balances are read in exactly two places: readNetByMember (used by readMembers, readBalancesForGroup, readNetBalanceForMember) which sums expense_payer minus expense_share only, and listGroupsForUser which repeats those sums inline. No activity feed routes exist under src/app; the only activity surface is GroupOverview's recent block, whose describe() is an exhaustive Record rendering actor plus a kind sentence only. The binding decisions are already in the code: balances read only from stored payer/share rows, and TR-4's rewrite (edit/delete replaces stored rows in one transaction with the activity entry). This plan extends that rule to payments: a payment is a stored row plus exactly one activity entry in one transaction, and balances sum stored expense rows plus stored payment rows.
